claim: For the first fiscal quarter of 2026, Intel cleared the $6.0B mark in gross profit.
summary: The claim concerns Intel Q1 FY2026 gross profit >$6.0B, a period ending and reporting after the 2026-01-04 knowledge cutoff. The value cannot be established from pre-cutoff knowledge alone.

sub_claims.text: Intel's gross profit for the first fiscal quarter of 2026 exceeded $6.0 billion
sub_claims.stated_text: cleared the $6.0B mark in gross profit
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04 predates Intel Q1 FY2026 period end (March 2026) and earnings report (typically April 2026); actual gross profit for that future period is not established by pre-cutoff knowledge, and no citations are to be invented.
